remarks: Welcome to 74 Lucy, a well-maintained all-brick Ranch in Maryvale School District, proudly owned by just two owners since it was built. Offering 1,280 square feet of living space, this home features 3 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms. The eat-in kitchen includes appliances and flows into the formal dining room, while the spacious living room provides plenty of room for everyday living. Original hardwood floors are found throughout the bedrooms and continue beneath the carpeted areas. The finished, dry basement adds additional living space and storage. Outside, enjoy the fully fenced backyard featuring a new deck, pergola, and beautiful vegetable gardens. The detached 2-car garage is equipped with automatic garage door openers. Additional updates and features include luxury vinyl flooring in the bathroom (2025), triple-pane thermal windows, basement drain tile (2020), a high-efficiency furnace, newer hot water tank, and a whole-house generator.
